Tim/project titles such as Queen of the Potatoverse or Queen of Martyverse belong to specific phases rather than permanent rank.

fruit.reading: Sammy's archive contains both ordinary companionship/loyalty and conflict/chaos. The March 2025 return-to-Garden scene is important because it prevents the conflict phase from becoming the whole judgment.
